# NagarNex

> Independent citizen-led waste accountability platform for Bengaluru: 15-second AI waste intake, 150m blackspot clustering, GPS-matched Before/After proof verification, 1-click community clean-up micro-drives, and a public QR rectified street board.

## Core Pages

- [NagarNex Home](https://nagarnex.vercel.app/): Landing page, live civic pulse KPIs, 5-step accountability loop, and 4-step Judge Demo Tour.
- [Live Bengaluru Map](https://nagarnex.vercel.app/map): Interactive Bengaluru waste blackspot map with 150m clustering, satellite/3D camera view, and collection hubs.
- [15-Second AI Waste Intake](https://nagarnex.vercel.app/intake): Capture or upload street waste photos for Gemini Vision AI classification, EXIF stripping, and GPS verification.
- [Bengaluru Ward Index](https://nagarnex.vercel.app/ward-index): Public ward clearance leaderboard, Civic Improvement Scores, and Open Data CSV export.
- [Community Micro-Drives](https://nagarnex.vercel.app/drives): 1-click volunteer RSVP for neighborhood clean-up sprints.
- [Public Roadside QR Board](https://nagarnex.vercel.app/board): Verified Before/After street clearances with scannable QR proof cards.

## API & Discovery

- [AI Vision Proxy](https://nagarnex.vercel.app/api/vision): Server-side Gemini Vision classification and Before/After verification endpoint (`POST`).
- [Sitemap](https://nagarnex.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of public NagarNex routes.
